owner_gate.action_before_claim: Implement one controller-local run_endpoint_owner.py and atomically persist ENDPOINT_OWNER_BINDING.json with the final owner sha256 and this readmission sha256.
required_behavior: Claim only h100-paged-fp8-e00mkpyvykfak0bg1m after ENDPOINT_OWNER_BINDING.json matches the final owner source.
Stage only paths enumerated by the project-local inputs/endpoint/ENDPOINT_INPUT_MANIFEST.json; never resolve or transfer a shared-source path after claim.
Copy to an isolated temporary root, verify every immutable identity there, and atomically promote only after the manifest passes.
Heartbeat the exclusive claim at intervals no longer than 45 seconds while staging, pulling, loading, measuring, retrieving, or repairing.
Execute the bound endpoint_pair.py outer command unchanged and run the sequential control/candidate pair exactly once.
On a recoverable pre-science or integration child exit, allocate a fresh repair-handshake generation, keep the outer owner live, and repair only the concrete mutable boundary.
Persist control success and never replay it after a later candidate-side recoverable failure.
Retrieve ENDPOINT_TERMINAL.json and arm diagnostics before release; retain a healthy candidate server and release the bench to maintenance.
Release by 2026-07-26T19:00:00Z under all terminal paths.

scientific_gates.request_identity: All 32 request SHA-256 values must match by arm.
scientific_gates.tokens: Both arms must return 32/32 complete rows with exactly 358 output tokens and exact raw SSE token IDs plus cumulative target traces matching control.
scientific_gates.target_semantics: The decode-equivalent NGRAM target path, checkpoint, image, server arguments, and workload bytes are identical by arm.
scientific_gates.no_fallback: Every custom-mask max_len_extend=12 call must route the candidate or fail immediately; local/global audit counts must be 5:1, multiples of 50/10, and equal the V2 dispatch counts.
